metadata.memory_method: peak RSS sampled every 10 ms from /proc/self/status VmRSS, minus pre-trial baseline RSS (0.0 where /proc is unavailable)
metadata.runtime_method: time.perf_counter around AssociationRulesEstimator.fit on a pre-encoded matrix (encoding time reported separately per dataset); mlxtend runtime covers TransactionEncoder-equivalent dense DataFrame build + apriori + association_rules

threshold_rationale.accidents: Large dense traffic data (340,183 transactions). Probes: at 0.50 FP-Growth OK (119.6 s) and Eclat OK (278.5 s), Apriori timed out, mlxtend was killed. 0.60 is added as a faster second point. Loader must exclude the leading '340183 468' header line.
threshold_rationale.adult_census: Medium census set (32,561 transactions, 6.19% density); 0.10 primary, 0.05 lower-support comparison.
threshold_rationale.balance_scale: Very small categorical set (625 transactions); two cheap points.
threshold_rationale.bms_pos: Large point-of-sale click-stream (515,596 transactions). Probes already showed 0.01 failing (Apriori timeout twice, FP-Growth killed twice), so only 0.02 is attempted.
threshold_rationale.bms_webview_1: Small click-stream with very short transactions (avg length 2.51); low thresholds are safe. File is tab-separated; the loader sniffs the delimiter.
threshold_rationale.bms_webview_2: Medium click-stream (77,512 transactions, avg length 4.62); low thresholds safe.
threshold_rationale.car_evaluation: Very small categorical set (1,728 transactions); two cheap points.
threshold_rationale.chess: Very dense (49.3%) with long transactions; 0.85 is the previously verified point. Lower thresholds explode rule counts (0.80 already yields ~552k rules), so a single high threshold is used.
threshold_rationale.connect: Very dense (33.3%) Connect-4 positions, 67,557 transactions. Probes already showed 0.90 failing (Apriori timeout, FP-Growth process killed), so only 0.95 is attempted; if it also fails it is recorded as a skip with the probe evidence.
threshold_rationale.docword_enron: Large document-word set (39,861 documents, avg length 93.1). Higher thresholds than NIPS because the set is 26x larger; 0.70 primary, 0.50 second point. If 0.50 times out it is recorded as a skip.
threshold_rationale.docword_nips: Document-word set (1,500 documents, avg length 497.5). Probes: at 0.50 all four engines OK and agreeing exactly (31,582 itemsets, 1,148,468 rules); at 0.30 all four timed out. Only 0.50 is attempted.
threshold_rationale.groceries: Classic sparse retail; 0.02 is the paper's verified point (122 itemsets, 49 rules, all engines agreeing); 0.01 adds a lower-support comparison.
threshold_rationale.kosarak: Largest set (990,002 click-stream transactions) but very sparse (0.02%). Low thresholds are feasible because few items are frequent; 0.01 is the primary point, 0.005 the lower-support comparison.
threshold_rationale.kosarak_spmf: Smaller SPMF sequence variant of kosarak (187,140 sequences). SPMF -1/-2 tokens must be stripped by the loader. Single threshold.
threshold_rationale.market_basket: Small sparse retail; both thresholds previously verified with all engines.
threshold_rationale.mushroom: Dense (19.3%) with 23-item transactions; 0.40 is the previously verified point. Single threshold to bound rule explosion on dense data.
threshold_rationale.online_retail: Retail with long transactions (avg length 25.1); 0.02 primary, 0.01 lower-support comparison. Cancelled invoices and non-positive quantities were already dropped in conversion.
threshold_rationale.online_retail_ii: Second retail set, same shape as online_retail (avg length 22.6); same thresholds for comparability.
threshold_rationale.pumsb: Dense census data with very long transactions (avg length 74). Only a high threshold is attempted to avoid candidate explosion; lower thresholds are not attempted, not hidden.
threshold_rationale.pumsb_star: Sparser census variant (avg length 50.5). Single high threshold for the same density reason as pumsb.
threshold_rationale.retail: Large sparse retail; 0.03 is the verified point for all three engines. 0.02 is included for a lower-support comparison; Apriori may time out there and that outcome is recorded, not hidden.
threshold_rationale.synthetic_dense_5000: Locally generated dense set (seed 42, 61.1% density, only 50 items); small and fast, two points.
threshold_rationale.synthetic_sparse_2000: Locally generated sparse set (seed 42, planted itemset {1,2,3}); small and fast, two points.
threshold_rationale.t10i4d100k: Standard synthetic benchmark (100,000 transactions); 0.01-0.02 is the published comparison range for this set.
threshold_rationale.tic_tac_toe: Very small categorical set (958 transactions); any threshold runs in seconds, so two points are cheap.
